response.justification: The candidate has extensive full-stack software engineering experience but lacks demonstrable expertise in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator hardware optimization, or deep-learning workload analysis — core requirements for the Principal Performance Architect role. His background is primarily in web, mobile, and DevOps tooling, with no evidence of hardware-software co-design, GPU architecture, or performance modeling for AI accelerators.
strengths: Strong full-stack development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Proven ability to build and contribute to open-source infrastructure projects
Demonstrated passion for teaching and sharing technical knowledge through workshops
concerns: No evidence of SoC, IP, or hardware modeling experience
Lacks background in AI accelerator optimization or deep-learning workload analysis
No exposure to GPU architecture, SIMD/MIMD, or hardware-software co-design as required

key_factors.factor: Absence of AI accelerator optimization background
